title: ShopEase — Overview (SLI / SLO / KPIs / Infra)
description: Uptime, latency, SLI/SLO, error rates, request totals, business KPIs, container & node CPU/memory, Postgres, S3 storage and telemetry-pipeline health. Data source: Grafana Mimir. Logs live in Kibana.

panels.title: Service status (black-box probe)
panels.description: 1 = the service's health endpoint answered 2xx in the last probe.

panels.title: Container restarts in range
panels.description: Non-zero = restarted within the selected range.

panels.title: Error rate % (5xx)
panels.description: Share of requests answered with HTTP 5xx. Red line = 1 %.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route, http_request_method) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="shopease-api", http_route!~"/api/health|/ready|/hello"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: SLI / SLO  (availability 99.9 %, latency: 95 % of requests under 500 ms)
Availability SLI (non-5xx)
panels.description: Good requests / all requests in range. SLO 99.9 %.

panels.title: Error budget remaining
panels.description: Budget = 0.1 % of requests may fail (99.9 % SLO). 100 % = untouched.

panels.title: Error-budget burn rate (5m and 1h)
panels.description: 1.0 = burning the budget exactly as fast as the SLO allows; >1 = SLO at risk.

panels.title: Business KPIs — live counters (OpenTelemetry manual metrics)
Login success rate
panels.description: A sudden drop can mean credential stuffing or a broken login.

panels.title: Transactional e-mails
panels.description: outcome=failed means the SMTP server rejected / was unreachable.

panels.title: Business KPIs — database view (source of truth, survives restarts)

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / on (name) sum by (name) (container_spec_cpu_quota{name!=""} / container_spec_cpu_period{name!=""} > 0)

panels.title: Container memory % of limit
panels.description: Working set / limit. Red line = alert threshold.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / on (name) sum by (name) (container_spec_cpu_quota{name!=""} / container_spec_cpu_period{name!=""} > 0)

panels.title: S3 storage (MinIO) — Mimir metric blocks, log archive, snapshots, uploads
S3 requests / sec
panels.description: Mimir block uploads, Logstash archive writes, ES snapshots and image uploads all show up here.

panels.title: Telemetry pipeline health (OTel Collector → Mimir / Logstash)
Log records sent to Logstash /s
panels.description: Failed > 0 for a while = Logstash/Elasticsearch down; the collector retries and queues.

options.content: **Logs:** open **[Kibana → ShopEase • Logs overview](http://localhost:5601/app/dashboards#/view/shopease-dashboard-logs)** or **[Discover](http://localhost:5601/app/discover)** (data view *ShopEase logs*). Filter a request end-to-end with `trace.id : "<id>"`.
